stop.kind: On curved G3 front surface; no separate flat diaphragm inserted

assembly_scheme: Five independent seated and locally bonded optical cells; common OD18 pilot; metal end-face stack in one OD21.6 barrel; nose lock ring

main: Insert cell 1 from +Z nose to -Z shoulder
Install nose lock ring; preload metal faces only

warnings: Demo omits optical clipping evaluation as requested. Original optical geometry and axial spacings are unchanged.
Ten STEP glasses form five groups; cover plate S16-S17 is in Zemax but absent from STEP and is not a barrel component.
The Zemax prescription is traced from infinity toward the specimen; +Z is the specimen/nose end.
Glue is three local fillets per cell, applied before insertion; no annular potting, no adhesive solid, no radial port required.
Curved surface seats are circular edge contacts, not full-area annular contacts; nominal radial overlap 0.5 mm.
Nominal thread envelope only; no actual thread flanks, material/fit classes, adhesive process or manufacturing tolerances specified.
New case: SolidWorks runtime verification pending.
